Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Bullet 1 - Grey")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Web Buttons and Bars.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Grey-ringed white-haloed silver-grey disc with a dark-grey play triangle.

cards.name: Bullet 1 - Orange
cards.summary: Symbol 'Bullet 1 - Orange' from Illustrator's Web Buttons and Bars symbol library: a round button with a pale grey outer ring and a white inner halo, a glossy orange disc, deep orange at the rim with a yellow-orange glow at the top, holding a dark-grey solid triangle pointing right, the play symbol. This one is a true orange. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 48 x 48 pt; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: play, next and go buttons on web pages
bullet markers for lists and links
call-to-action buttons in app and banner mock-ups
avoid: a labelled button: the glyph has no text; add the label beside it with the Type tool
a flat look: the gloss and halo are baked in; break the link and set flat fills for a flat design
